mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS nodeId, p.node_name AS nodeName, p.status AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS resourceCount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS stepCount, COUNT(DISTINCT dm.device_id) AS deviceCount FROM process_node p LEFT JOIN resource_room r ON r.process_node_id = p.id LEFT JOIN step_node s ON s.resource_room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN device_mount dm ON (dm.resource_room_id = r.id OR dm.step_node_id = s.id) WHERE p.route_version_id = #{routeVersionId} GROUP BY p.id, p.node_name, p.status

SELECT d.id AS deviceId, d.device_code AS deviceCode, d.device_name AS deviceName, dm.mount_type AS mountType, s.id AS sourceStepId, s.node_name AS sourceStepName FROM device_mount dm JOIN device d ON d.id = dm.device_id LEFT JOIN step_node s ON dm.step_node_id = s.id WHERE dm.resource_room_id = #{resourceRoomId} ORDER BY d.device_code
